example_en: Investigators quickly homed in on a single suspect.
Our homeroom teacher checks attendance every morning.
The store cuts prices on household appliances every January.

meaning_ko: 초이동성(더 빠르게 더 멀리 더 자주 이동하는 현상)
example_en: Hyper-mobility has reshaped the way big cities plan their roads.
In a hyperconnected office, no one ever thinks alone.

meaning_ko: 측정할 수 없음, 헤아릴 수 없음
example_en: The immeasurability of the night sky fills us with awe.

meaning_ko: 맥락과 동떨어진 상태에서, 다른 요인을 무시한 채; 진공 속에서
example_en: No public policy is ever made in a vacuum.
She is in charge of the school library.
The new hall was built in keeping with the older buildings.

meaning_ko: 지나가는 말로, 말이 나온 김에 잠깐
example_en: He mentioned the resignation only in passing.
In reply, she simply nodded and walked away.
He fixed my bike in return for a ride home.
Clean water was in short supply after the storm.
In the absence of hard evidence, the case was dropped.
In the event of a fire, take the stairs, not the lift.
Data gathered in this manner is easy to compare later.

meaning_ko: 구별할 수 없는, 알아볼 수 없을 만큼 똑같은
example_en: To the naked eye the two copies are indiscernible.
The treaty stresses the indivisibility of basic human rights.
The bright green wall looked inharmonious with the old furniture.

meaning_ko: 의도성(마음이나 행동이 무언가를 향해 있는 성질), 고의성
example_en: Philosophers argue about the intentionality of belief and desire.

meaning_ko: 내면화(외부의 규범·가치를 자기 것으로 받아들이는 과정)
example_en: Internalization of classroom rules takes young children some time.
The speed of light stays invariant for every observer.
The old castle is said to be haunted.
Our sales still lag behind those of our main rival.

meaning_ko: 해고된, 정리 해고당한 (lay off 의 과거·과거분사)
example_en: Hundreds of workers were laid off when the plant closed.

meaning_ko: 경관 정체성(한 지역의 풍경이 지니는 고유한 성격)
example_en: Stone walls and hedges give the valley its landscape identity.
The team moved on to a larger-scale experiment last year.

meaning_ko: 최후의 수단(다른 방법이 모두 실패했을 때 쓰는 것)
example_en: Surgery is a last resort for this kind of injury.

meaning_ko: 라스트 마일의(최종 목적지까지 남은 마지막 구간의)
example_en: Electric scooters solve the last-mile problem for many commuters.

meaning_ko: 꽉 붙잡았다, 매달렸다; (생각·유행을) 덥석 받아들였다 (latch onto 의 과거)
example_en: The frightened child latched onto her mother and would not let go.
Good scientists explain their work so that lay people can follow it.

meaning_ko: 선도 사용자(미래의 수요를 앞서 겪고 스스로 해법을 만들어 쓰는 사용자)
example_en: Lead users often build their own gear long before companies sell it.

meaning_ko: 가장 ~할 것 같지 않은, 가능성이 가장 낮은
example_en: Teenagers are the least likely group to read a printed newspaper.
You left out the one detail that really mattered.
The trip takes less than an hour by train.

meaning_ko: 수업 지도안, 수업 계획서 (lesson plan 의 복수)
example_en: She writes her lesson plans every Sunday evening.

meaning_ko: 발광 기관(반딧불이 등이 빛을 내는 신체 기관)
example_en: Fireflies flash signals to each other with their light organs.

meaning_ko: 즐겨 이야기하곤 했다 (like to + 동사원형: ~하기를 좋아하다)
example_en: My uncle liked to tell the same joke at every dinner.
We locked in a low interest rate before the rise.

meaning_ko: ~에게는 통하지 않다, 이해되거나 인식되지 못하다 (be lost on someone)
example_en: The irony was completely lost on the younger students.
Carving wood well demands years of manual skill.
She earned a master's degree in marine biology.

meaning_ko: 판단 기준, 척도; 길이를 재는 자
example_en: Test scores are a poor measuring stick for creativity.

meaning_ko: (어떤 것에서) 뽑아낼 수 있는 효과·이득, 활용도; 주행 거리, 연비
example_en: The band got enormous mileage out of one catchy song.
The farmer sold the mineral rights under his fields.
Poor lighting led to the misidentification of the suspect.
It is a common misperception that lightning never strikes twice.
The first edition was full of embarrassing misprints.

meaning_ko: A를 B로 착각하다, A를 B로 잘못 알다
example_en: People often mistake kindness for weakness.

meaning_ko: 청자·관객을 대하는 화법, 말 거는 방식(작품이 독자를 부르는 태도)
example_en: The documentary adopts an intimate mode of address.

meaning_ko: ~을 본보기로 삼아 내 삶을 꾸렸다 (model one's life after: ~을 본받아 살다)
example_en: He modeled his career after the teacher who first believed in him.
A modeling shadow along the jaw makes a flat face look round.

meaning_ko: 일원론자(모든 것이 하나의 원리·실체로 이루어졌다고 보는 사람), 일원론적인
example_en: A monist denies any real gap between mind and body.

meaning_ko: 두 배가 넘는, 두 배 이상
example_en: The town is more than twice the size it was in 1990.
Multiculturalists argue that schools should teach many traditions at once.

meaning_ko: 서로 알아들을 수 있는(통역 없이 뜻이 통하는)
example_en: Norwegian and Swedish are largely mutually intelligible.

meaning_ko: ~의 이름을 따서 지어진 (name after 의 수동형)
example_en: The park was named after a local poet.

meaning_ko: 꼭 알아야 할 사람에게만 알리는, 필요 최소한의 정보만 주는
example_en: The files are shared strictly on a need-to-know basis.
The new bridge brings a clear net benefit to the town.

meaning_ko: 글 읽는 법을 끝내 배우지 못했다
example_en: He never learned to read, yet he knew hundreds of songs by heart.
